attributes.description: Inventory Shadow AI tools on macOS endpoints — local LLMs, AI coding agents, AI desktop applications, MCP servers (MCP config file presence, metadata only), AI model files, Python/npm AI packages, browser extensions (Chrome, Firefox, Safari), Docker containers, launchd services, Homebrew packages, AI API key exposure, and AI tool configuration directories, vector databases, model cache sizes, and SSH tunnels for AI services.
attributes.name: ai-asset-discovery-macos

queries.query:
SELECT
    name,
    path,
    cmdline,
    pid,
    username,
    resident_size,
    start_time,
    ppid,
    category
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.name,
        p.path,
        p.cmdline,
        p.pid,
        u.username,
        p.resident_size,
        datetime(p.start_time, 'unixepoch') AS start_time,
        p.parent AS ppid,
        CASE
            WHEN (p.cmdline LIKE '%@modelcontextprotocol/%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-server-%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp_server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%fastmcp%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%modelcontextprotocol%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%smithery%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcpx%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-run%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%glama%mcp%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-proxy%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-gateway%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%supergateway%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%github-mcp-server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@modelcontextprotocol/server-%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-remote%'
    OR LOWER(p.name) IN('github-mcp-server', 'mcp-server-github')) THEN 'mcp'
            WHEN (LOWER(p.name) IN('claude', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'warp', 'zed', 'tabnine', 'wasmtabnine', 'codeium_language_server', 'supermaven', 'amazon-q', 'pieces-os', 'pieces os', 'codex', 'aider', 'sgpt', 'augment', 'goose', 'devin', 'gemini-cli', 'genaiscript', 'opencode', 'kiro', 'kilocode')
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%claude-code%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@anthropic/claude-code%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@anthropic-ai/claude-code%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%claude_desktop%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%com.anthropic.claudedesktop%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%Cursor.app%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%Cursor Helper%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor-retrieval%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%Windsurf%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%codeium_language_server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%codeium%enterprise%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%github.copilot%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%copilot-agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%copilot-language-server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@openai/codex%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%aider-chat%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%aider%--model%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%saoudrizwan.claude-dev%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%rooveterinaryinc.roo-cline%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%continue.continue%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%continuedev%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%amazon-q%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%codewhisperer%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%AmazonWebServices.amazon-q%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%sourcegraph.cody%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%tabnine%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%dev.warp.Warp%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%dev.zed.Zed%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%shell_gpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%shell-gpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openhands%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%swe-agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%pieces-os%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%supermaven%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%augment%code%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openai/codex%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%goose%session%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openclaw%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%moltbot%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%clawdbot%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%autogpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%auto-gpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%babyagi%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%agentgpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%crewai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%semantic-kernel%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%semantic_kernel%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama-index%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama_index%'
    
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%opencode%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%kilocode%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vscodium%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%kiro%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@cursor/agent%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor-cli%') THEN 'agent'
            WHEN (LOWER(p.name) IN('ollama', 'lms', 'gpt4all', 'jan', 'msty', 'local-ai', 'koboldcpp', 'llama-server', 'llama-cli', 'vllm', 'mlc_llm', 'mlc_chat', 'anythingllm', 'anything-llm', 'litellm', 'open-webui', 'llamafile', 'text-generation-launcher', 'text-generation-router', 'comfyui', 'invokeai', 'exo', 'tabby', 'qwen', 'grok')
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%ollama serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vllm.entrypoints%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%text-generation-launcher%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%koboldcpp%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama-server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama.cpp%server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llamafile%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mlc_llm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%litellm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%open-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%anythingllm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%localai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%text-generation-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%oobabooga%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%comfyui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%invokeai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%stable-diffusion-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%whisper%server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%msty%serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%tabby%serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%exo serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%exo-launcher%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cohere serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mistral serve%') THEN 'llm_runtime'
        END AS category
    FROM processes p
    LEFT JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid
) AS ai_procs
WHERE category IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    l.port,
    l.address,
    l.protocol,
    p.name,
    p.path,
    p.cmdline,
    p.pid
FROM listening_ports l
JOIN processes p ON l.pid = p.pid
WHERE (
    l.port IN (11434, 1234, 7860)
    OR (
        l.port IN (43411, 4891, 1337, 5001, 8080, 8000, 4000, 3000, 3001, 8188, 9090, 1000, 8501, 8265, 9099, 5678, 8888)
        AND (
            p.name IN ('ollama', 'lms', 'gpt4all', 'jan', 'vllm', 'litellm', 'koboldcpp', 'llama-server', 'llamafile', 'open-webui', 'anythingllm', 'comfyui', 'invokeai', 'claude', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'warp', 'copilot-agent', 'aider', 'codex', 'tabby', 'exo', 'bolt', 'replit', 'devin', 'goose', 'augment', 'supermaven', 'gemini-cli', 'opencode', 'kiro', 'kilocode')
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%ollama%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vllm%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%litellm%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama-server%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama.cpp%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%open-webui%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%anythingllm%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%claude-code%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor-retrieval%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%github.copilot%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-server%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@modelcontextprotocol%'
        )
    )
    OR (
        l.port = 18789
        AND (
            p.cmdline LIKE '%openclaw%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%moltbot%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%clawdbot%'
            OR p.name LIKE '%openclaw%'
        )
    )
)
AND l.address != '127.0.0.1'
AND l.address != '::1';

SELECT
    name,
    path,
    bundle_identifier,
    bundle_short_version AS version,
    datetime(last_opened_time, 'unixepoch') AS last_opened_time,
    CASE
        WHEN name = 'Microsoft Copilot' OR name LIKE '%Microsoft Copilot%' THEN 'productivity'
        WHEN name LIKE '%Copilot%' THEN 'unknown'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS copilot_variant
FROM apps
WHERE name IN (
    'Ollama', 'LM Studio', 'GPT4All', 'Jan', 'Msty', 'AnythingLLM',
    'ChatGPT', 'Claude', 'Perplexity', 'DeepSeek', 'Poe',
    'Google Gemini', 'Microsoft Copilot',
    'Cursor', 'Windsurf', 'Zed', 'Warp', 'Void',
    'Pieces OS', 'Replit',
    'DiffusionBee', 'Draw Things',
    'Otter', 'Granola', 'Krisp', 'Raycast', 'TypingMind',
    'Notion', 'Craft', 'Grammarly Desktop'
)
    OR bundle_identifier IN (
    'com.openai.chat',
    'com.anthropic.claudedesktop',
    'ai.perplexity.app',
    'com.todesktop.230313mzl4w4u92',
    'com.ollama.ollama',
    'com.quora.poe',
    'dev.zed.Zed',
    'dev.warp.Warp-Stable',
    'com.raycast.macos',
    'ai.krisp.krispMac',
    'com.lmstudio.app',
    'com.codeium.windsurf',
    'io.gpt4all.gpt4all',
    'jan.ai',
    'com.diffusionbee.diffusionbee',
    'com.liuliu.draw-things',
    'notion.id',
    'com.lukilabs.lukiapp',
    'com.pieces.os',
    'com.msty.app',
    'com.grammarly.ProjectLlama'
)
    OR name LIKE '%Qwen%'
    OR name LIKE '%Grok%'
    OR name LIKE '%Gemini%'
    OR name LIKE '%Bolt%'
    OR name LIKE '%Replit%'
    OR name LIKE '%Ghostwriter%'
    OR name LIKE '%Bito%'
;

SELECT
    path,
    size,
    type,
    username,
    modified_time,
    accessed_time,
    config_kind
FROM (
    SELECT
        f.path,
        f.size,
        f.type,
        u.username,
        datetime(f.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS modified_time,
        datetime(f.atime, 'unixepoch') AS accessed_time,
        CASE
            WHEN (f.path LIKE '/Users/%/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.claude.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.claude/settings.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.cursor/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.mcp.json'
OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.kiro/settings/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.gemini/settings.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.codex/config.toml'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.config/opencode/opencode.json'

    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/Documents/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/Projects/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/dev/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/src/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/repos/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/code/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/Documents/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/Projects/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/dev/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/src/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/repos/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/code/%/.vscode/mcp.json') THEN 'mcp_config'
            WHEN ((f.type = 'directory' AND (f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.ollama'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.cursor'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.claude'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.continue'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.codeium'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.tabnine'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.supermaven'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.anythingllm'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.invokeai'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/jan'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/lm-studio'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/huggingface'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/gpt4all'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/llama.cpp'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.config/github-copilot'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.config/shell_gpt'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.gemini'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.codex'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.kiro'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.config/opencode'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.openclaw'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.lmstudio'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.hermes'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.kilocode'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.cursor/skills'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.cursor/skills-cursor'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.cursor/plugins'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.cursor/hooks'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.claude/skills'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.claude/plugins'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.claude/hooks'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.codex/skills'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.openclaw/skills'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.openclaw/hooks'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.kilocode/skills'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.continue/skills'))) THEN 'tool_directory'
            WHEN (f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.aider.conf.yml') THEN 'tool_config'
        END AS config_kind
    FROM file f
    LEFT JOIN users u ON f.uid = u.uid
) AS ai_config
WHERE config_kind IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    path,
    filename,
    size,
    datetime(mtime, 'unixepoch') AS modified_time,
    datetime(atime, 'unixepoch') AS accessed_time,
    CASE
        WHEN path LIKE '/Users/%/.ollama/models/%' THEN 'ollama'
        WHEN path LIKE '/Users/%/.lmstudio/%' OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/lm-studio/%' THEN 'lm-studio'
        WHEN path LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/huggingface/%' THEN 'huggingface'
        WHEN path LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/llama.cpp/%' THEN 'llama.cpp'
        WHEN path LIKE '/Users/%/.local/share/nomic.ai/GPT4All/%' THEN 'gpt4all'
        WHEN path LIKE '/Users/%/jan/models/%' THEN 'jan'
        WHEN path LIKE '/Users/%/Downloads/%' THEN 'download'
        ELSE 'other'
    END AS tool
FROM file
WHERE (
    path LIKE '/Users/%/.ollama/models/blobs/%'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.ollama/models/%/%'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.lmstudio/models/%'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/lm-studio/%'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/huggingface/hub/%'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/huggingface/hub/%.safetensors'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/huggingface/hub/%.gguf'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/llama.cpp/%'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/llama.cpp/%.gguf'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.local/share/nomic.ai/GPT4All/%'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.local/share/nomic.ai/GPT4All/%.gguf'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/jan/models/%'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/Downloads/%.gguf'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/Downloads/%.safetensors'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/Downloads/%.llamafile'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/Downloads/%.ggml'
    OR path LIKE '/Users/%/Downloads/%.onnx'
)
AND size > 104857600;

SELECT
    name,
    version,
    directory
FROM python_packages
WHERE name IN (
    'torch', 'tensorflow', 'onnxruntime', 'jax', 'flax',
    'transformers', 'diffusers', 'accelerate', 'peft', 'trl',
    'huggingface-hub', 'tokenizers', 'datasets', 'sentence-transformers',
    'safetensors',
    'openai', 'anthropic', 'google-generativeai', 'cohere', 'replicate',
    'groq', 'mistralai', 'together', 'fireworks-ai', 'deepseek-sdk',
    'langchain', 'langchain-core', 'langchain-community',
    'llama-index', 'llama-index-core',
    'autogen', 'crewai', 'semantic-kernel', 'haystack-ai', 'dspy-ai',
    'instructor', 'guidance', 'outlines',
    'llama-cpp-python', 'ollama', 'vllm', 'ctransformers',
    'bitsandbytes', 'auto-gptq', 'exllama',
    'fastmcp', 'mcp',
    'chromadb', 'qdrant-client', 'weaviate-client', 'pinecone-client',
    'pymilvus', 'faiss-cpu', 'faiss-gpu',
    'aider-chat', 'shell-gpt', 'mentat',
    'gradio', 'streamlit',
    'openai-whisper', 'whisper', 'elevenlabs', 'bark',
    'litellm',
    'llm'
);

SELECT
    ce.name,
    ce.identifier,
    ce.version,
    ce.description,
    ce.path,
    ce.state,
    u.username,
    CASE
        WHEN ce.name LIKE '%GitHub Copilot%' OR ce.identifier LIKE '%github%copilot%' THEN 'developer'
        WHEN ce.name LIKE '%Microsoft%Copilot%' OR ce.identifier LIKE '%microsoft%copilot%' THEN 'productivity'
        WHEN ce.name LIKE '%Copilot%' OR ce.identifier LIKE '%copilot%' THEN 'browser'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS copilot_variant
FROM users u CROSS JOIN chrome_extensions ce USING(uid)
WHERE ce.state = 1 AND (
    ce.name LIKE '%Copilot%' OR ce.name LIKE '%ChatGPT%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Claude%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Gemini%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Perplexity%' OR ce.name LIKE '%DeepSeek%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Monica%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Merlin%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Sider%' OR ce.name LIKE '%MaxAI%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%UseChatGPT%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Poe%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Cody%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Codeium%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Tabnine%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Blackbox%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Phind%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Bito%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Grammarly%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Jasper%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Wordtune%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Quillbot%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%QuillBot%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Compose AI%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Writesonic%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Copy.ai%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%You.com%' OR ce.name LIKE '%AIPRM%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%WebChatGPT%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%Glasp%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Eightify%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%NoteGPT%' OR ce.name LIKE '%tl;dv%'
    OR ce.name LIKE '%DeepL%' OR ce.name LIKE '%Immersive Translate%'
    OR ce.identifier IN (
        'fjoaledfpmneenckfbpdfhkmimnjocfa',
        'ngjjaadpdmddgbpmipagccngfbpmekei',
        'hcmjdjeeoimlofdjmfpbpamldmmiifne',
        'eollffkcakepchajholpcojldgkiikmf',
        'kbbdabhdfibfiedgpfkhdnbdilnjohlm',
        'aajjgdpofhhcffcgighomdiodecghjdd'
    )
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%chatgpt%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%copilot%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%claude%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%perplexity%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%deepseek%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%openai%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%anthropic%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%codeium%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%tabnine%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%grammarly%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%deepl%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%monica%'
    OR ce.identifier LIKE '%sider%'
);

SELECT
    id,
    name,
    image,
    status,
    command,
    datetime(replace(substr(started_at, 1, 19), 'T', ' ')) AS started_at
FROM docker_containers
WHERE
    image LIKE '%ollama%' OR image LIKE '%vllm%'
    OR image LIKE '%text-generation%' OR image LIKE '%localai%'
    OR image LIKE '%llama.cpp%' OR image LIKE '%litellm%'
    OR image LIKE '%pytorch%' OR image LIKE '%tensorflow%'
    OR image LIKE '%triton%' OR image LIKE '%huggingface%'
    OR image LIKE '%modelcontextprotocol%' OR image LIKE '%mcp-server%' OR image LIKE '%fastmcp%'
    OR image LIKE '%open-webui%' OR image LIKE '%anythingllm%'
    OR image LIKE '%flowise%' OR image LIKE '%langflow%'
    OR image LIKE '%chromadb%' OR image LIKE '%chroma%'
    OR image LIKE '%qdrant%' OR image LIKE '%weaviate%'
    OR image LIKE '%milvus%' OR image LIKE '%pinecone%'
    OR image LIKE '%comfyui%' OR image LIKE '%stable-diffusion%'
    OR image LIKE '%invokeai%' OR image LIKE '%automatic1111%'
    OR image LIKE '%n8n%' OR image LIKE '%openhands%'
    OR image LIKE '%sweepai%' OR image LIKE '%pr-agent%'
    OR image LIKE '%qwen%'
    OR image LIKE '%grok%'
    OR image LIKE '%cohere%'
    OR image LIKE '%mistral%';

SELECT
    label,
    path,
    program_arguments,
    run_at_load
FROM launchd
WHERE label LIKE '%ollama%' OR label LIKE '%lmstudio%'
    OR label LIKE '%gpt4all%' OR label LIKE '%jan%'
    OR label LIKE '%anythingllm%' OR label LIKE '%pieces%'
    OR label LIKE '%open-webui%' OR label LIKE '%litellm%'
    OR label LIKE '%comfyui%' OR label LIKE '%invokeai%'
    OR program_arguments LIKE '%ollama%'
    OR program_arguments LIKE '%llama-server%'
    OR program_arguments LIKE '%litellm%'
    OR program_arguments LIKE '%mcp-server%';

SELECT
    name,
    version,
    description,
    path,
    directory,
    depth
FROM npm_packages
WHERE (
    name LIKE '@modelcontextprotocol/%'
    OR name LIKE 'mcp-server-%'
    OR name LIKE '@anthropic-ai/%'
    OR name LIKE '@elastic/mcp%'
    OR name LIKE '@github/mcp-server%'
    OR name LIKE 'mcp-remote%'
    OR name LIKE '@openai/%'
    OR name LIKE '@google/gemini-cli%'
    OR name LIKE '@google/generative-ai%'
    OR name LIKE '@google-cloud/vertexai%'
    OR name LIKE '@langchain/%'
    OR name LIKE 'langchain%'
    OR name LIKE '@continuedev/%'
    OR name LIKE '@mistralai/%'
    OR name LIKE '@cohere/%'
    OR name LIKE '@githubnext/%copilot%'
    OR name LIKE '@github/copilot%'
    OR name LIKE 'gemini-cli%'
)
AND depth = 0;

SELECT
    fa.name,
    fa.identifier,
    fa.version,
    fa.description,
    fa.path,
    fa.active,
    u.username,
    CASE
        WHEN fa.name LIKE '%GitHub Copilot%' OR fa.identifier LIKE '%github%copilot%' THEN 'developer'
        WHEN fa.name LIKE '%Microsoft%Copilot%' OR fa.identifier LIKE '%microsoft%copilot%' THEN 'productivity'
        WHEN fa.name LIKE '%Copilot%' OR fa.identifier LIKE '%copilot%' THEN 'browser'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS copilot_variant
FROM users u CROSS JOIN firefox_addons fa USING(uid)
WHERE fa.active = 1 AND (
    fa.name LIKE '%Copilot%' OR fa.name LIKE '%ChatGPT%'
    OR fa.name LIKE '%Claude%' OR fa.name LIKE '%Gemini%'
    OR fa.name LIKE '%Perplexity%' OR fa.name LIKE '%DeepSeek%'
    OR fa.name LIKE '%Monica%' OR fa.name LIKE '%Merlin%'
    OR fa.name LIKE '%Sider%' OR fa.name LIKE '%MaxAI%'
    OR fa.name LIKE '%UseChatGPT%' OR fa.name LIKE '%Poe%'
    OR fa.name LIKE '%Cody%' OR fa.name LIKE '%Codeium%'
    OR fa.name LIKE '%Tabnine%' OR fa.name LIKE '%Blackbox%'
    OR fa.name LIKE '%Phind%' OR fa.name LIKE '%Bito%'
    OR fa.name LIKE '%Grammarly%' OR fa.name LIKE '%Jasper%'
    OR fa.name LIKE '%Wordtune%' OR fa.name LIKE '%Quillbot%'
    OR fa.name LIKE '%QuillBot%' OR fa.name LIKE '%Compose AI%'
    OR fa.name LIKE '%Writesonic%' OR fa.name LIKE '%Copy.ai%'
    OR fa.name LIKE '%You.com%' OR fa.name LIKE '%AIPRM%'
    OR fa.name LIKE '%WebChatGPT%'

SELECT

SELECT

    ve.vscode_edition,

    u.username,
    datetime(ve.installed_at, 'unixepoch') AS installed_at,
    CASE
        WHEN ve.name LIKE 'github.copilot%' THEN 'developer'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS copilot_variant
FROM users u
CROSS JOIN vscode_extensions ve USING(uid)
WHERE ve.name IN (
    'github.copilot',
    'github.copilot-chat',
    'saoudrizwan.claude-dev',

SELECT
    name,
    version,
    path
FROM homebrew_packages
WHERE name IN (
    'ollama', 'llama.cpp', 'llamafile', 'gpt4all',
    'vllm', 'litellm', 'localai',
    'huggingface-cli', 'transformers',
    'pytorch', 'tensorflow',
    'cursor', 'zed', 'warp',
    'aider', 'shell-gpt', 'llm',
    'chromadb', 'qdrant',
    'comfyui', 'whisper', 'whisper-cpp',
    'jupyterlab', 'jupyter'

SELECT
    p.name,
    p.path,
    p.cmdline,
    p.pid,
    u.username,
    p.resident_size,
    datetime(p.start_time, 'unixepoch') AS start_time
FROM processes p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid
WHERE p.name IN ('qdrant', 'milvus', 'weaviate', 'chroma')
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%chromadb%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%qdrant%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%weaviate%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%milvus%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%pinecone%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%pgvector%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%lancedb%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%faiss%';

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN f.directory LIKE '%/.ollama/models%' THEN 'ollama'
        WHEN f.directory LIKE '%/.cache/huggingface%' THEN 'huggingface'
        WHEN f.directory LIKE '%/.cache/lm-studio%' THEN 'lm-studio'
    END AS ai_tool,
    CASE
        WHEN f.directory LIKE '%/.ollama/models%' THEN '/Users/*/.ollama/models'
        WHEN f.directory LIKE '%/.cache/huggingface%' THEN '/Users/*/.cache/huggingface'
        WHEN f.directory LIKE '%/.cache/lm-studio%' THEN '/Users/*/.cache/lm-studio'
    END AS cache_path,
    SUM(f.size) AS total_bytes,
    COUNT(*) AS file_count
FROM file f
WHERE (
    f.directory LIKE '/Users/%/.ollama/models%'
    OR f.directory LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/huggingface%'
    OR f.directory LIKE '/Users/%/.cache/lm-studio%'
)
    AND f.type = 'regular'
GROUP BY ai_tool
HAVING total_bytes > 104857600;

SELECT
    f.path,
    f.size,
    datetime(f.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS modified_time,
    datetime(f.ctime, 'unixepoch') AS changed_time,
    u.username
FROM file f
LEFT JOIN users u ON f.uid = u.uid
WHERE (
    f.path LIKE '/Users/%/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.claude.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.claude/settings.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.cursor/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.mcp.json'
OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.kiro/settings/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.gemini/settings.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.codex/config.toml'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.config/opencode/opencode.json'

    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/Documents/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/Projects/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/dev/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/src/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/repos/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/code/%/.mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/Documents/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/Projects/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/dev/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/src/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/repos/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/code/%/.vscode/mcp.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.aider.conf.yml'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/Library/Application Support/Ollama/config'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.config/ollama/config'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.continue/config.json'
    OR f.path LIKE '/Users/%/.codeium/config.json'
)
AND f.mtime > (strftime('%s', 'now') - 7200);

SELECT
    p.name AS process_name,
    p.path AS process_path,
    p.pid,
    u.username,
    sens.path AS sensitive_file_path,
    sens.size AS sensitive_file_size,
    datetime(sens.atime, 'unixepoch') AS accessed_time,
    datetime(sens.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS modified_time
FROM processes p
JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid
JOIN (
    SELECT path, size, atime, mtime, uid
    FROM file
    WHERE path LIKE '/Users/%/.aws/credentials'
        OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.aws/config'
        OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.ssh/id_rsa'
        OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.ssh/id_ed25519'
        OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.ssh/id_ecdsa'
        OR path LIKE '/Users/%/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome/Default/Login Data'
        OR path LIKE '/Users/%/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db'
        OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.config/gcloud/credentials.db'
        OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json'
        OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.azure/accessTokens.json'
        OR path LIKE '/Users/%/.azure/msal_token_cache.json'
) AS sens ON p.uid = sens.uid
JOIN process_open_files pof ON pof.pid = p.pid AND pof.path = sens.path
WHERE (p.name IN ('ollama', 'claude', 'cursor', 'Cursor', 'windsurf', 'Windsurf', 'copilot-agent', 'aider', 'ChatGPT', 'codex', 'lms', 'gpt4all', 'jan', 'koboldcpp', 'llama-server', 'vllm', 'litellm', 'qwen', 'grok', 'gemini-cli', 'genaiscript', 'devin', 'goose', 'warp', 'zed', 'augment', 'supermaven')
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%claude-code%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%ollama serve%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor-retrieval%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%github.copilot%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%codeium%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-server%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@modelcontextprotocol%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openclaw%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%moltbot%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%clawdbot%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%autogpt%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%crewai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%gemini-cli%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%genaiscript%')
queries.description: AI process sensitive-file access evidence via process_open_files. Reports credential-adjacent path metadata only; no file content.

SELECT
    p.name AS process_name,
    p.path AS process_path,
    p.cmdline,
    p.pid,
    u.username,
    pos.remote_address,
    pos.remote_port,
    pos.local_port,
    pos.local_address,
    pos.state,
    CASE pos.family
        WHEN 2 THEN 'IPv4'
        WHEN 10 THEN 'IPv6'
        ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS address_family,
    CASE pos.protocol
        WHEN 6 THEN 'tcp'
        WHEN 17 THEN 'udp'
        ELSE CAST(pos.protocol AS TEXT)
    END AS transport_protocol,
    CASE
        WHEN pos.remote_address LIKE '10.%' OR pos.remote_address LIKE '192.168.%' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_rfc1918_destination
    datetime(p.start_time, 'unixepoch') AS start_time
FROM process_open_sockets pos
JOIN processes p ON pos.pid = p.pid
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid
WHERE pos.remote_address NOT IN ('127.0.0.1', '::1', '0.0.0.0', '::')
    AND pos.remote_address != ''
    AND (pos.state IN ('ESTABLISHED', 'CLOSE_WAIT', 'SYN_SENT') OR pos.state IS NULL)
    AND (
        p.name IN ('ollama', 'claude', 'cursor', 'Cursor', 'windsurf', 'Windsurf',
                  'ChatGPT', 'chatgpt', 'copilot-agent', 'copilot', 'claude-code',
                  'Cursor Helper', 'cline', 'codeium',

                  'exo', 'qwen', 'grok', 'gemini-cli', 'genaiscript', 'openai', 'llm',
                  'bolt', 'replit', 'ghostwriter', 'bito', 'devin', 'goose', 'warp',
                  'zed', 'Zed', 'augment', 'supermaven')
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%ollama serve%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%claude-code%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor-retrieval%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%codeium%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%github.copilot%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama-server%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vllm.entrypoints%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-server%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@modelcontextprotocol%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%openclaw%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%moltbot%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%clawdbot%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%gemini-cli%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%genaiscript%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%autogpt%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%crewai%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%api.openai.com%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%api.anthropic.com%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%generativelanguage.googleapis.com%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%api.cohere.ai%'
        OR p.cmdline LIKE '%api.mistral.ai%'
    );
